paper.title_en: Topology of the Fermi surface and universality of the metal-metal and metal-insulator transitions: $d$-dimensional Hatsugai-Kohmoto model as an example
paper.abstract_en: The earlier theory [1] of the quantum phase transitions related to the change of the Fermi Surface Topology (FST) is advanced. For such transitions the Fermi surface as a quantum critical manifold determined by the Lee-Yang zeros, the order parameter $\mathcal{P}$ as the $d$-volume of the Fermi sea, and the special FST universality class were introduced in [1]. The exactly solvable Hatsugai-Kohmoto (HK) $d$-dimensional ($d=1,2,3$) model of interacting fermions is analyzed. We explore the relation between the Lee-Yang zeros, the Luttinger and the plateau (Oshikawa) theorems. The validity of the Luttinger theorem in the HK model is confirmed. It is shown that the order parameter $\mathcal{P}$ and the FST universality class describe the transitions between metal and band/Mott insulators, as well as the Lifshitz and van Hove gapless-to-gapless transitions. The gapless phases are established to be the Landau Fermi liquids (metals). In addition to the conventional paradigm with a continuous order parameter, we apply the homology theory to analyze the FST transitions. They are critical points of the Morse function. To quantify FST we use the Euler characteristic, which is calculated for each phase of the HK model. We claim that the FST universality class is robust with respect to interactions and other model details, under the condition that the critical points are non-degenerate.

decision.title_zh: 费米面拓扑与金属-金属及金属-绝缘体相变普适性：以 $d$ 维 Hatsugai-Kohmoto 模型为例
decision.abstract_zh: 本文推进了此前关于费米面拓扑（FST）变化相关量子相变的理论[1]。对于这类相变，[1]中引入了作为由 Lee-Yang 零点决定的量子临界流形的费米面、作为费米海 $d$-体积的序参量 $\mathcal{P}$ 以及专门的 FST 普适类。本文分析了精确可解的相互作用费米子 Hatsugai-Kohmoto（HK）$d$ 维（$d=1,2,3$）模型。我们探讨了 Lee-Yang 零点、Luttinger 定理与平台（Oshikawa）定理之间的关系。HK 模型中 Luttinger 定理的有效性得到确认。结果表明，序参量 $\mathcal{P}$ 与 FST 普适类描述了金属与能带/莫特绝缘体之间的转变，以及 Lifshitz 与 van Hove 无隙到无隙转变。无隙相被确认为朗道费米液体（金属）。除了具有连续序参量的传统范式之外，我们应用同调理论来分析 FST 转变。它们是 Morse 函数的临界点。为了量化 FST，我们使用 Euler 示性数，并对 HK 模型的每个相分别计算了该量。我们声称，在临界点非简并的条件下，FST 普适类对相互作用及其他模型细节具有鲁棒性。
